answer: The atlas lists forty falcon routes each epoch, and no route flies twice. A claimant carries a live parcel along a vine trellis through three relay points in 20 minutes, each signed by a stranger, at most two each. Entry locks 70 POA, +40 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,500 POA. One operator flies two routes at most, so ten fakes need five hands, ten flights, thirty relay signatures at once. A missed relay burns 20; one parcel flown on two routes burns both bonds. The ledger reads relay times against funding roots and voids any route flown by a hand already counted.
